schema.title: Harness Session
schema.description: Correlates an external coding harness thread or session with a Siftable work item without coupling core to any runner.

harness.description: External agent harness or runner name.

workId.description: Siftable work item UUID associated with this session.

threadId.description: Runner-local thread, conversation, or session identifier.

model.description: Optional model identifier used in the session.

branch.description: Optional git branch associated with the session.

worktreePath.description: Optional local git worktree path for the session.

deepLink.description: Optional deep link back to the external harness session.
